auditSummary: Reconciled authoritative satellite scenes, acquisition timestamps, and uncertainty statistics for UrjaSetu Pune heat intelligence.

geographicCoverage.studyAreaDelineation: PMC Candidate Boundary (synthesized from 23 Prabhag wards, non-statutory)

landsat9.collection: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature Science Product
landsat9.reconciliationNote: Reconciled against conflicting 2024-05-18 citations. The physically verified raster archive in UrjaSetu corresponds to the April 22, 2023 pre-monsoon scene.

uncertaintySTQA.description: USGS per-pixel uncertainty estimate from Surface Temperature Quality Assessment band (ST_QA, scale factor 0.01 K).
uncertaintySTQA.errorCorrectionNote: The uniform ±0.81 K claim found in legacy notes misattributes global sensor-level laboratory validation to field retrievals. Actual field uncertainty varies per-pixel with mean 2.16 K.

landsat9.phenomenologicalScope: Radiometric land surface skin temperature (T_skin) at instantaneous sensor overpass. It does NOT represent 2-meter ambient air temperature (T_air) or Wet-Bulb Globe Temperature (WBGT).

sentinel2b.temporalBaselineNote: Acquired approximately 48 hours after Landsat 9 overpass, providing a synchronized pre-monsoon dry-season baseline.

aggregationToTargetGrid.method: Exact area-weighted polygon intersection of native 10m pixels onto 30m Landsat grid cells

sentinel2b.phenomenologicalScope: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) indicates photosynthetic activity and chlorophyll vigor. It does NOT establish canopy height, volumetric tree shade, structural species composition, or total green cover percentage.
